description: The plot illustrates how BLEU varies with the length of a “gold prefix,” showing two series across the same x-axis. The x-axis is labeled “the length of gold prefix,” uses a linear scale, and spans integer values from 0 to 20 with major ticks at 0, 5, 10, 15, and 20. The y-axis is labeled “BLEU,” uses a linear scale, and ranges from 23 to 29 with tick marks at each integer. One line is a blue dashed line with open circle markers; it starts near 24.6 at x=0, dips to about 23.7 at x=1, then generally rises with small fluctuations, reaching about 26.0–26.2 around x=12–13 and ending near 28.1 at x=20. The other line is an orange dashed line with filled square markers labeled “Inconsistency: wait-9”; it begins around 25.1 at x=0, increases to roughly 25.7–25.8 by x=2, fluctuates around 25.4–26.0 through about x=9 (with a local high near 26.0 around x=6), then trends downward to about 25.1 around x=14–15, stays near 25.1–25.4 through x=19, and ends around 25.9 at x=20.
